_comment: Routing policy for the video stack. Tier membership is EDITORIAL — the OpenRouter API exposes price and capability, not quality. Reorder these lists as real output is reviewed; nothing here is derived from the API.

draft.description: Iteration passes. Cheapest capable model, lowest resolution, audio off. Never ships to a client.

standard.description: Client-quality SaaS and social work. 720p, audio only when the shot needs it.

branded.description: Shots carrying on-screen brand text, logos, or motion transfer, where character and text fidelity matter more than price.

premium.description: Hero shots only. Budget-gated by design — one Veo 3.1 shot costs more than a whole draft pass.

local_scene_types._comment: Scene types rendered locally by local-render.js at zero model cost. A generative model is never billed for these.
